events.title: Philly Fed Index Plunges Much More Than Expected In November
events.description: The Federal Reserve Bank of Philadelphia released a report on Thursday showing regional manufacturing was less widespread in the month of November but continued to expand overall.

events.title: U.S. Weekly Jobless Claims Unexpectedly Inch Higher
events.description: First-time claims for U.S. unemployment benefits unexpectedly edged slightly higher in the week ended November 14th, according to a report released by the Labor Department on Thursday.

events.title: Euro Rises As Risk-Appetite Improves
events.description: The euro strengthened against other major currencies in the European session on Thursday, as European stocks edged higher after three days of losses. Technology stocks were rising after Anthropic raised $81.3 billion in the largest stock-market debut on record.

events.title: Euro Rises Against Majors
events.description: The euro strengthened against other major currencies in the European session on Thursday.

events.title: FTSE 100 Hovers Near 6-Week Lows On Consumer Sector Decline
events.description: The FTSE 100 dropped to 10,524.60, down 0.25%, as consumer sector losses offset gains elsewhere. Investec fell 6.6% and JD Sports Fashion dropped 4.2% after cutting profit guidance. Mulberry plunged 22% despite turnaround progress.

events.title: NZ Dollar Rises Amid Risk-on Mood
events.description: The New Zealand dollar strengthened against other major currencies in the European session on Thursday, as European stocks traded higher after three days of losses. Technology stocks were rising after Anthropic raised $81.3 billion in the largest stock-market debut on record.

events.title: Indian Shares Rebound Led By Auto And Bank Stocks
events.description: Indian shares rebounded sharply on Thursday after falling notably in the previous session due to profit taking after recent string of gains.

events.title: French Stock Market Climbs On Tech, Finance Gains
events.description: France's CAC 40 index rose 0.26% to 8,167.90 Thursday, rebounding after three consecutive days of losses. Technology stocks led gains following Anthropic's record $81.3 billion IPO. STMicroElectronics surged over 4.5%, while Soitec soared 15% after announcing 40% annual revenue growth targets.

events.title: German Stocks Rise On Tech Boost; DAX Up 0.23%
events.description: German stocks gained ground Thursday after three consecutive sessions of losses. The DAX benchmark rose 0.23% to 25,817.00, supported by tech strength following Anthropic's record $81.3 billion IPO. Infineon Technologies led gains with a 3.5% climb.

events.title: Gold Holds Steady After Hitting 14-month Low
events.description: Gold prices were flat to slightly higher on Thursday after falling more than 3 percent on Wednesday to their lowest level since September 2025, pressured by a stronger dollar and hawkish Fed remarks.

events.title: Oil Prices Little Changed As Traders Weigh Supply Outlook
events.description: Oil prices were little changed on Thursday after falling sharply in the previous session on expectations of a looming supply glut.

events.title: NZ Dollar Rises Against Majors
events.description: The New Zealand dollar strengthened against other major currencies in the European session on Thursday.

events.title: European Shares Edge Higher In Cautious Trade
events.description: European stocks edged higher on Thursday after three days of losses. Technology stocks were rising after Anthropic raised $81.3 billion in the largest stock-market debut on record.
